Contains the Austrian population subdivided into persons in private households (e.g. spouse, child, living alone) and persons in non-private households (e.g. institutional households). A family nucleus consists of couples (married or cohabiting) with or without children, or parents with one or more children living in the household. According to family statistics, all biological children, step children and adopted children, who do not have an own partner and have no child of their own while still living in the household of their parents are regarded as children, regardless of their age. Partners in a married couple: Includes persons in registered partnerships.
